```
## [YYYY-MM-DD] Story X.X — <story name>
**Status:** complete | partial | blocked
**Files added:** ...
**Files changed:** ...
**What changed:** one to three plain sentences.
**Checked how:** what you ran or looked at, and with what data or setup.
**Deviations from the plan:** anything built differently than the plan says, and why.
**Plan updates needed:** the exact story and the exact change. Do not edit the plan yourself.
**Open questions / follow-ups:** anything the next session should know.
```

Entries that are not a story use the same fields with one of these headings: `## [YYYY-MM-DD] Plan updated — <what changed>`, `## [YYYY-MM-DD] Brief changed — <what changed>`, `## [YYYY-MM-DD] Feature <n> added — <name>`, `## [YYYY-MM-DD] Package regenerated — <why>`, or `## [YYYY-MM-DD] Note — <from whom, what>` (a note has no status).
